fee_notes: Single Unit fee is $50,000, fully earned and non-refundable. Under the Multi-Unit Development Agreement (MUDA), the first unit is $50,000 and each additional unit (up to 4 additional, 5 total) is discounted to $37,500. During fiscal year ending December 31, 2024, actual Initial Franchise Fees paid ranged from $0 to $50,000, with adjustments based on number of locations, franchisee history, and Development Area size.
raw_excerpt:
Our initial franchise fee under the Single Unit Franchise Program is $50,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is fully earned when paid. In no event is the Initial Franchise Fee refundable.

During our fiscal year ending December 31, 2024, the range of actual Initial Franchise Fees paid was $0 to $50,000.
